UI_FloppyFabrics_Enable_Tooltip: Master switch. Off: every flag, curtain and banner is drawn as in vanilla and nothing is simulated. Applies immediately.
UI_FloppyFabrics_Wind_Tooltip: The wind the fabric feels. Vanilla = the game's wind. Calm caps it at a fresh breeze, Breezy and Windy keep fabric moving on still days. Direction is always the game's. Custom uses the two sliders below.
UI_FloppyFabrics_WindMin_Tooltip: Only with Custom. The fabric always feels at least this much wind (1 = 120 km/h). 0 = vanilla.
UI_FloppyFabrics_WindMax_Tooltip: Only with Custom. Stronger wind is capped here (1 = 120 km/h, no cap). At or below the minimum: a steady wind at the minimum.
UI_FloppyFabrics_Quality_Description: Lower quality reduces CPU cost. Attachment points, stability and multi-tile cloths are kept at any setting.
UI_FloppyFabrics_Quality_Tooltip: Sets simulation detail, how many cloths move at once and how far away they move. High is the default. Custom uses the three sliders below.
UI_FloppyFabrics_Detail_Tooltip: Only with Custom. Resolution of every simulated cloth, string and awning, from 0.5x (fastest) to 4x the default (1x). Moving fabric restarts from rest when it changes.
UI_FloppyFabrics_MaxActive_Tooltip: Only with Custom. The nearest this many flags and curtains are simulated each frame; the rest hold still. Default 64.
UI_FloppyFabrics_SimDistance_Tooltip: Only with Custom. Fabric farther than this many tiles from you holds still. Default 45.
UI_FloppyFabrics_Interactions_Tooltip: Players, zombies, vehicles and furniture push and drape cloth. Off: wind only.
UI_FloppyFabrics_Curtains_Tooltip: Curtains move while their window is open or broken.
UI_FloppyFabrics_CurtainLight_Tooltip: Daylight flickers into the room when the wind lifts a curtain.
UI_FloppyFabrics_Decorations_Tooltip: Strings, awnings and market canopies move. Off: drawn as in vanilla.
